name: dreamcart
description: Isomorphic JS game runtime + framework for PSP, Web, 3DS and dual-screen Android. All scripts run on Bun.

scripts.deploy: bun web/deploy-build.ts && bunx wrangler pages deploy web/site --project-name dreamcart
scripts.bake: bun framework/bake/bake-font.ts && bun framework/bake/bake-sprites.ts && bun framework/bake/bake-gltf.ts && bun framework/bake/bake-scene.ts && bun framework/bake/bake-bsp.ts box && bun framework/bake/bake-bsp.ts zfight
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc -p framework/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bunx tsc -p framework/games/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: bun framework/test/contract.ts && bun framework/test/controller.test.ts && bun framework/test/action.test.ts && bun framework/test/scene-desc.test.ts && bun framework/test/golden.ts && bun framework/test/bsp-parse.test.ts && bun framework/test/bsp-bake.test.ts && bun framework/test/bsp-walk.test.ts && bun framework/test/bsp-gen.test.ts
scripts.build: bun run bake && bun run typecheck && bun run bundle && bun run web
scripts.android:install: cd android && ./gradlew :app:installDebug && adb shell am start -n games.dreamcart/.MainActivity
